name: 西施
prompt:
Transform the supplied Xi Shi (西施) character portrait into a clearly HAND-PAINTED CHINESE GONGBI + INK-WASH + RICH MINERAL-PIGMENT illustration. This is a style edit. The user approves the richness of the outfit but says the current image looks too real. Make it unmistakably painted, with visible calligraphic linework and paper texture, while PRESERVING the opulent clothing and jewelry. Do not simplify her dress back into plain linen.

REFERENCE / EDIT TARGET: xi_shi-richcolor-512.png.
PRESERVE: same adult Chinese woman, graceful oval face, approximately age 23, reflective expression, eye direction, three-quarter pose, pinned-up dark hair. Keep emerald-jade outer silk robe, deep red inner lapels, ivory inner collar, dense gold scrolling / angular woven ornament across lapels and sleeves, jade fastening, ornate gold-and-white-jade hair ornaments and delicate earrings. Keep the same DEGREE OF OPULENCE and the same emerald / crimson / antique-gold color hierarchy. Ornament and rich layers must remain clearly readable. Keep fully clothed chest and shoulders.
CHANGE THE MEDIUM RADICALLY:
The final image must look like a high-quality original traditional Chinese figure painting reproduced on subtly textured xuan paper, not a photograph of a costumed woman, not a 3D render, not a movie still. Fine expressive ink outlines define eyelids, brows, nose, lips, fingers-of-hair, collar and garment folds. Deliberate flowing line rhythm, subtly varied stroke thickness, elegant slightly stylized facial construction. Model the face with thin translucent layers of warm ochre and pale blush using painted tonal shapes, not smooth photographic skin gradients. No pores, no makeup advertising skin, no glassy wet lips, no plastic or hyperreal eyes. Show brush decisions.
Render the hair as organized broad black ink masses with a few lively calligraphic strand strokes and selective dry-brush texture. NOT thousands of photographically sharp individual hairs.
Render the extravagant green silk using substantial flat / gently modulated MALACHITE mineral-green and indigo washes, defined by strong expressive ink fold lines. Preserve gorgeous gold motifs but render the gold as fine hand-painted muted gold pigment and controlled decorative lines, NOT reflective 3D metal or computer glitter. The red inner robe is CINNABAR / deep carmine pigment wash. The jade accessories are delicately outlined celadon / white painted shapes, with very restrained pale ink highlights, not jewelry photography.
INCREASE WATER-INK FEEL:
Visible natural xuan-paper fiber/grain within pigment, light pooling and granulation of mineral colors, subtle bleeding at secondary edges, softly broken dry-brush at lower shoulders. Strong legible painted face and jewelry contours, looser expressive wash toward silhouette edges. A balanced mixture of controlled gongbi detail in face and rich garment patterns, with spontaneous ink atmosphere around the figure.
BACKGROUND:
Replace the realistic palace scene, lanterns and photographic bokeh with a minimal painterly wash on WARM LIGHT IVORY XUAN PAPER: a few broad diffused pale gray-blue / ink-green washes, generous quiet paper space around her face. No realistic scenery, no camera blur, no lantern circles, no architectural details. The figure remains jewel-colored and luxurious; ONLY the background is pale and quiet. Avoid turning the garments brown or desaturated. The pale paper is not dirty yellow vintage grunge.
COMPOSITION: one single square upper-body portrait, face large, rich shoulders and sleeves occupy lower half, hair ornaments fully inside canvas with comfortable top margin. Aim for a refined hand-painted Chinese historical-game portrait. Target final 512 x 512. No text, calligraphy writing, seal, signature, watermark, border or UI.
STRICTLY AVOID: photorealism, camera language, cinematic rim light, optical bokeh, realistic skin pores, glossy lips, reflective metal jewelry rendering, hyperreal silk texture, Unreal Engine, 3D, anime, chibi, paper cutout. Also avoid simplistic plain robes, muddy sepia monochrome, overly pale desaturated clothes, crude flat cartoon face, or a different person. Rich GONGBI COLOR AND DECORATION plus unmistakable CHINESE INK AND BRUSH QUALITY.
